name: North Perth FMC Day 2025
information: **IMPORTANT** This competition **does not** hold the 3x3x3 Rubik's Cube event. This is a fewest moves solving competition ONLY. This competition will run on the same weekend as [South Perth FMC Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthPerthFMCDay2025) ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Whadjuk Noongar people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
